name: recovery-plan
title: Recovery plan review copy
for_each: select id,name from plans order by name

sections.title: Approval and dates
sections.note: Check version and status before use. This is a review copy, not an emergency instruction issued to staff.

sections.title: Service objectives
sections.sql: select s.name,s.impact,s.rto_hours,s.rpo_hours,s.max_outage_hours from services s join plans p on p.service_id=s.id where p.id=$1

sections.title: Dependencies and alternatives
sections.sql: select d.name,d.owner,d.recovery_hours,d.workaround,d.evidence,d.verified_on from dependencies d join plans p on p.service_id=d.service_id where p.id=$1 order by d.name

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_date,severity from actions where plan_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_date

name: exercise-report
title: Exercise outcome and follow-up
for_each: select id,name from exercises order by name

sections.title: Corrective actions
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_date,severity,status,evidence from actions where exercise_id=$1 order by due_date
